title: An algebra through which every finitely presented algebra factors via a class E is a filtered colimit of members of E
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\Lambda$ a commutative $R$-algebra, and $\mathcal E$ a set of commutative $R$-algebras each of finite presentation over $R$ (isomorphic as $R$-algebras to $R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m)$ for some $n,m\ge0$). Assume: for every $R$-algebra $A$ of finite presentation and every homomorphism of $R$-algebras $\alpha:A\to\Lambda$ there are $B\in\mathcal E$ and homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $\beta:A\to B$, $\gamma:B\to\Lambda$ with $\gamma\circ\beta=\alpha$. Then $\Lambda$ is a filtered colimit of members of $\mathcal E$: there are a small filtered category $J$, a functor $j\mapsto B_j$ from $J$ to commutative $R$-algebras with $B_j\in\mathcal E$ for all $j$, and homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $\iota_j:B_j\to\Lambda$ such that $(\Lambda,(\iota_j)_j)$ is a colimit of this diagram in the category of commutative $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 07C3 (lemma-when-colimit, line 31952), proof of (2) implies (1): the full subcategory of the category of Lemma Tag 0BUF (lemma-ring-colimit-fp-category, line 31771: finitely presented R-algebras over Lambda, filtered with colimit Lambda) on the objects A -> Lambda with A in E is cofinal and filtered (Categories, Lemma Tag 0BUC, lemma-cofinal-in-filtered, categories.tex line 2230), so Lambda is its colimit (Categories, Lemma Tag 04E7, lemma-cofinal, line 1760); the converse direction (1) implies (2) is the node lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-algebra-factors-filtered-colimit

proof.text: Step 1 (small representatives). Mathlib proves that the category of finitely generated R-algebras is essentially u-small (CommAlgCat/FiniteType.lean). Its inclusion has essentially small essential image, so the finite-type object property is essentially small. Finite presentation implies finite type; therefore the finite-presentation property FP and the membership property E are essentially small. ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.exists_small_le chooses small properties P₀ ≤ FP and E₀ ≤ E with FP ≤ P₀.isoClosure and E ≤ E₀.isoClosure. Set P = P₀ ⊔ E₀. Every member of P is finitely presented and every finitely presented algebra is isomorphic to a member of P. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-colimit-fp-algebras-over-it] to obtain small filtered I = CostructuredArrow P.ι Λ and its canonical colimit cocone c with vertex Λ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 07C3 (lemma-when-colimit, line 31952), proof, second paragraph: 'Consider the category I of Lemma 0BUF'; Lemma Tag 0BUF (line 31771) and its footnote (objects restricted to a set)

proof.text: Step 2 (factorization into the full subcategory). Let Q(i) mean E₀(i.left.obj), and let F : Q.FullSubcategory → I be the full inclusion. For i = (A, α), apply hfactor to obtain B ∈ E and β : A → B, γ : B → Λ with β ≫ γ = α. Since E ≤ E₀.isoClosure, choose B′ ∈ E₀ and e : B ≅ B′. The object j = (B′, e.inv ≫ γ) belongs to Q, and β ≫ e.hom defines a morphism i → F(j): its commuting triangle follows from e.hom ≫ e.inv = id and β ≫ γ = α. Thus every object of I maps to an object of Q.FullSubcategory.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 07C3 (lemma-when-colimit, line 31952), proof, second paragraph ('the full subcategory J consisting of those A -> Lambda with A in E'); hypothesis (2) of the lemma

proof.text: Step 3 (filteredness and restriction). Use the filtered duals of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-initial-full-subcategory]: IsFiltered.of_exists_of_isFiltered_of_fullyFaithful makes Q.FullSubcategory filtered, and Functor.final_of_exists_of_isFiltered_of_fullyFaithful makes F final. Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv transports hc to IsColimit (c.whisker F), keeping the vertex Λ and its canonical coprojections [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Categories, Lemma Tag 0BUC (lemma-cofinal-in-filtered, line 2230: J is filtered and cofinal in I) and Lemma Tag 04E7 (lemma-cofinal, line 1760: colim over J = colim over I), as cited in the proof of Algebra, Lemma Tag 07C3

proof.text: Step 4 (small index and conclusion). The object projection Q.FullSubcategory → I is injective, so this full subcategory is small. Let e = Shrink.equivalence into J = Shrink Q.FullSubcategory in Type (max u v). Transfer filteredness by IsFiltered.of_equivalence and whisker c.whisker F with e.inverse; its colimit property transfers by Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv since an equivalence is final [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-initial-full-subcategory]. The vertex is still Λ, the diagram object at j is the underlying algebra of F(e.inverse.obj j), and it lies in E because E₀ ≤ E. This gives the requested diagram, natural transformation, membership proof and IsColimit witness [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].
